Name: Crossingway
Author: XIVTheCalamity
Description:
Renders browser overlays in-game for FFXIV Traditional Chinese server (API 12 / .NET 9).
Use the settings button below or the '/cw config' command to configure.
Fork of Browsingway by Styr1x.
Changelog:
- Fix buffer overflow on window resize
- Fix crash on dropdown/popup interaction (shared memory mode)
- Fix double DPI scaling of popup position
- Add popup overlay for external links
- Fix IINACT EndCombat NullReferenceException
- Shared memory IPC fallback for DXMT (macOS/Wine)
